title: Moonlit Harbor alpha status
brief: Lanternfish Games is building Moonlit Harbor, and the producer, Zuri Okonkwo-Hale, needs a status page for the publisher ahead of the alpha review on 2026-11-20, as of week 42 (ending 2026-10-16). Overall the project is amber. Headlines: 31 of 40 planned features complete (77.5 percent), 14 of 18 levels playable, 212 open bugs of which 9 are priority 1, and an average of 58 frames per second on the minimum-spec console against a target of 60. Open bugs by week: W37 340, W38 318, W39 291, W40 264, W41 238, W42 212, falling by about 26 a week, which would leave about 80 open by 2026-11-20. Under "Features" give the 9 remaining ones by status: 4 in progress (fishing mini-game, ship customization, co-op invites, photo mode), 3 not started (harbor festival events, achievements, accessibility options), 2 cut candidates (weather-driven trading, pet companion). Under "Risks": performance is 2 frames per second below target in the busiest harbor scene and the optimization sprint is booked for 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-13; accessibility options have not started and are required for the console certification submission on 2027-02-08; the two cut candidates would save about 6 weeks of work if dropped, and the decision is needed by 2026-10-30. Sections: "Alpha at a glance", "Bug trend", "Features" and "Risks".

edit.request: Add W43 at 190 open bugs and make the headline 190, and mark photo mode as complete, so 32 of 40 features are done.
